An [[Ebruchi]] was the '''chieftain''' of the [[Ebruchi (fleet)|Ebruchi fleet's]] [[Flux Screw fleet]], [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding]] the Ebruchi [[high captain]] known as "[[Common Cork]]." The [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] was a member of an [[Unidentified Ebruchi clan|Ebruchi clan]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ebruchi chieftain was introduced in the [[2010]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
